# src/wiki/community

The community wikis as a set, the curl client one of them needs, and their credit.

| File | Purpose | Exports |
|---|---|---|
| `credits.ts` | Attribution for the community wikis this package reads. | WIKI_CREDIT_SOURCES, WIKI_ATTRIBUTION |
| `index.ts` | The community wikis as a set: | — |
| `transport-curl.ts` | A `fetch`-shaped transport backed by curl, for wikis that refuse Node. | createCurlFetch, isCurlAvailable |
| `types.ts` | The types `wiki/community/` exports, in one place — so a neighbouring module finds the shape it needs here instead of declaring its own under a second name. | CurlFetchOptions, WikiSource, WikiFetchOptions, WikiSearchHit |
| `wikis.ts` | The Tower's community wikis, as a set rather than a single site. | WIKI_SOURCES, DEFAULT_WIKI_SOURCE_ID, getWikiSource, WIKI_USER_AGENT (+6 more) |
